keyFeatures: Visual wheel assessment of work-life integration across key life dimensions
Identifies gaps between your current satisfaction and ideal state in each area
Highlights which dimensions need the most attention for better balance
Track changes over time to see whether your work-life integration is improving
tips: Rate each dimension based on how satisfied you currently feel, not how objectively well things are going — your subjective experience is what matters for balance.
Look for the areas with the lowest scores first: even small improvements in your lowest-rated dimensions tend to have the biggest impact on overall life satisfaction.
